paper_title: Evaluation of Speaker Anonymization on Emotional Speech
caption: Original distribution of emotion categories in the IEMOCAP dataset. Percentages are displayed with respect to number of utterances.
model_annotation: The pie chart illustrates the original distribution of emotion categories in the IEMOCAP dataset, with percentages representing the proportion of utterances for each emotion. The chart is divided into six segments, each labeled with an emotion and its corresponding percentage. The largest segment is "Frustration" at 25.1%, shown in light blue, followed by "Neutral" at 23.1% in dark blue. "Sadness" accounts for 14.7% and is colored orange, while "Anger" represents 14.9% and is depicted in yellow. "Excitement" makes up 14.1% and is shown in red, and "Happiness" is the smallest segment at 8.1%, colored in a lighter red or pinkish tone. The segments are arranged in a clockwise order starting from the top right, and each slice includes its percentage label directly within the chart. The chart does not include a separate legend, as the labels are clearly associated with their respective slices. The proportions are visually proportional to their percentages, with "Frustration" and "Neutral" being the most prominent categories.
